name: Boku ja Nai Dareka no Ude ni Dakarete Iru Kanojo
original_name: 僕じゃない誰かの腕に抱かれている彼女
source:
Girl confesses first to the boy, and they start dating. Classmates, friends, teachers, parents - all oppose these relations and try to separate the children. Envy and betrayal awaits at every corner.
Why reality is so cruel? Is there hope in the end of the way?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女孩先向男孩告白，两人开始交往。同学、朋友、老师和父母都反对这段关系，试图拆散他们。每个角落都等待着嫉妒与背叛。

为什么现实如此残酷？道路尽头还有希望吗？

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
